introduction: 211 Colorado connects residents with local food, housing, utility, child care and other assistance providers. Start with your ZIP code and the help you need.
description: 211 Colorado connects residents with local food, housing, utility, child care and other assistance providers. Start with your ZIP code and the help you need.

sections.who: The directory is available to people seeking help in Colorado. Each referred provider has its own service area and eligibility rules.
sections.get: You receive contact information and guidance on where to ask for assistance. A referral does not reserve funding or approve a benefit.
sections.docs:
• Your ZIP code or county.
  • A short explanation of the need and any urgent deadline.
  • Notes about transport, language or accessibility needs.
sections.apply:
1. Call or search

    Dial 211, call 866-760-6489, or text your ZIP code to 898-211. You can also search 211 Colorado online.

  2. Explain the immediate problem

    Tell the navigator whether you need food today, face a utility shutoff, or need longer-term support.

  3. Contact the provider

    Ask each referral about current intake, required documents and available appointments. Keep the name and phone number.
sections.after: If a referral is closed or has no funds, return to 211 and ask for another option in your area.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using 211 Colorado; State library’s 211 information. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
